Explore the **feature vectors** that drive the Hybrid Fusion Reranker.
Visualize semantic scores, BM25 scores, token overlap, and more.

## Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup
from reranker.embedder import Embedder
from reranker.strategies.hybrid import HybridFusionReranker

embedder = Embedder()
```

## Sample Data

```{python}
#| label: sample-data
demo_queries = [
    "python dataclass default factory",
    "machine learning model deployment",
]

demo_docs = [
    "In Python, a dataclass field can use default_factory to generate mutable default values like lists or dictionaries.",
    "Dataclasses in Python 3.7+ provide a decorator that automatically generates __init__, __repr__, and __eq__ methods.",
    "The default_factory parameter in field() is called when a default value is needed for a new instance.",
    "Use dataclasses.field(default_factory=list) to create a new list for each instance rather than sharing one.",
    "FastAPI relies heavily on Python dataclasses and Pydantic models for request validation.",
    "ML model deployment can use FastAPI to serve predictions via REST endpoints with automatic OpenAPI docs.",
    "XGBoost and LightGBM models can be serialized and served through ONNX Runtime for production inference.",
    "Containerizing ML models with Docker ensures reproducible deployment across environments.",
]

query = demo_queries[0]
docs_to_analyze = demo_docs[:6]
print(f"Query: {query}")
print(f"Documents: {len(docs_to_analyze)}")
```

## Train Hybrid Reranker

```{python}
#| label: train
#| cache: true
import numpy as np

demo_pairs = [
    (demo_queries[0], demo_docs[0], 1.0),
    (demo_queries[0], demo_docs[1], 0.6),
    (demo_queries[0], demo_docs[2], 0.9),
    (demo_queries[0], demo_docs[3], 0.8),
    (demo_queries[0], demo_docs[4], 0.3),
    (demo_queries[1], demo_docs[5], 0.9),
    (demo_queries[1], demo_docs[6], 0.7),
    (demo_queries[1], demo_docs[7], 0.5),
]

reranker = HybridFusionReranker(embedder=embedder)
q_list = [p[0] for p in demo_pairs]
d_list = [p[1] for p in demo_pairs]
s_list = [float(p[2]) for p in demo_pairs]
reranker.fit_pointwise(q_list, d_list, s_list, use_regression=True)
print(f"Hybrid fitted: {reranker.is_fitted}")
print(f"Features: {reranker.feature_names_}")
```

## Feature Matrix

```{python}
#| label: feature-matrix
X = reranker._build_features(query, docs_to_analyze) if query and docs_to_analyze else None
feature_names = reranker.feature_names_

if X is not None and len(X) > 0:
    print("## Feature Matrix\n")
    header = "| Feature | " + " | ".join(f"Doc {i + 1}" for i in range(X.shape[0])) + " |"
    sep = "|" + "--------|" * (X.shape[0] + 1)
    print(header)
    print(sep)
    for fname in feature_names:
        idx = reranker._feature_registry.get(fname)
        if idx is not None and idx < X.shape[1]:
            vals = " | ".join(f"{X[r, idx]:.4f}" for r in range(X.shape[0]))
            print(f"| {fname} | {vals} |")
else:
    print("*No features to display.*")
```

## Feature Value Bar Chart

```{python}
#| label: plot-feature-bars
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

if X is not None and len(X) > 0 and X.shape[1] > 0:
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(8, X.shape[1] * 0.8), max(4, len(docs_to_analyze) * 0.6)))
    n_docs = X.shape[0]
    n_features = X.shape[1]
    bar_width = 0.8 / n_docs
    indices = np.arange(n_features)

    for doc_idx in range(n_docs):
        offset = (doc_idx - n_docs / 2 + 0.5) * bar_width
        ax.barh(indices + offset, X[doc_idx], bar_width, label=f"Doc {doc_idx + 1}")

    ax.set_yticks(indices)
    ax.set_yticklabels(feature_names, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel("Feature Value")
    ax.set_title("Feature Values per Document")
    ax.legend(fontsize=7)
    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

## Semantic Similarity

```{python}
#| label: semantic-similarity
#| cache: true
if query and docs_to_analyze:
    q_vec = embedder.encode([query])[0]
    d_vecs = embedder.encode(docs_to_analyze)
    sem_scores = [float(np.dot(q_vec, d)) for d in d_vecs]
    max_score = max(sem_scores) if sem_scores else 1.0
    top_idx = sem_scores.index(max_score)

    print("## Semantic Similarity\n")
    print(f"**Query:** `{query}`\n")
    for i, s in enumerate(sem_scores):
        best = "← best" if i == top_idx else ""
        print(f"- Doc {i + 1}: **{s:.4f}** {best}")
        print(f"  > {docs_to_analyze[i][:120]}")
else:
    print("*No data to analyze.*")
```

## Pairwise Cosine Distance Matrix

```{python}
#| label: plot-distance-matrix
#| cache: true
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist

if query and docs_to_analyze and len(docs_to_analyze) >= 2:
    all_texts = [query] + docs_to_analyze
    vecs = embedder.encode(all_texts)
    dist_matrix = cdist(vecs, vecs, metric="cosine")

    fig2, ax2 = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6))
    labels = ["QUERY"] + [f"Doc {i + 1}" for i in range(len(docs_to_analyze))]
    im = ax2.imshow(dist_matrix, cmap="YlOrRd", aspect="auto")
    ax2.set_xticks(range(len(labels)))
    ax2.set_yticks(range(len(labels)))
    ax2.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=7, rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax2.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=7)
    ax2.set_title("Pairwise Cosine Distance Matrix")
    for i in range(len(labels)):
        for j in range(len(labels)):
            ax2.text(j, i, f"{dist_matrix[i, j]:.2f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=6)
    fig2.colorbar(im, ax=ax2, shrink=0.8)
    fig2.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

## Dataset Label Distribution

```{python}
#| label: label-distribution
score_dist = {}
for p in demo_pairs:
    s = p[2]
    score_dist[s] = score_dist.get(s, 0) + 1

print("## Dataset Label Distribution\n")
print("| Score | Count |")
print("|-------|-------|")
for score, count in sorted(score_dist.items()):
    print(f"| {score} | {count} |")
```
